## Help
- The Help menu has **Read Me** (this version's README) and **File Format Reference** (the current format reference), alongside **Release Notes**.
## For developers
This release is mostly for people who want to build their own tools for the 3rd Wave.
- **The format reference** ([`docs/FORMATS.md`](https://github.com/adambier/3rd-wave-tools/blob/v1.0.5/docs/FORMATS.md)) now gives the evidence for each statement in footnotes (a test on a 3rd Wave, or Groove Synthesis's own documents), says inferences in words, and states plainly what it does not cover: the structure of every file is known, but what most of a program's values mean is not yet known, so it supports tools that read, pack, unpack, convert, and rename programs, not yet tools that edit sounds. - **Test files** in [`fixtures/`](https://github.com/adambier/3rd-wave-tools/tree/v1.0.5/fixtures): a small file of each kind, each with a JSON file of what it should parse to, for checking a reader or writer in any language. - **Two Swift libraries.** `PgdataFormats` reads and writes the four formats, packs and unpacks `.pgdata` files, and converts older programs; `PgdataPackerCore` holds this app's own decisions without its user interface, for a command-line tool or an app on another platform that should behave like pgdata Packer. Both depend only on Foundation, and their tests run on macOS, Linux, and Windows for every change. - **Documentation** for `PgdataFormats`, with a getting-started guide: [adambier.github.io/3rd-wave-tools](https://adambier.github.io/3rd-wave-tools/documentation/pgdataformats/). - **[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/adambier/3rd-wave-tools/blob/v1.0.5/CONTRIBUTING.md)** explains how to help, above all with corrections to the format reference.
Nothing changes in how the app packs or unpacks.

## Updates
- pgdata Packer now updates itself, using Sparkle. On its second launch it asks whether to check for updates automatically; **Check for Updates…** in the app menu checks at any time. Updates are signed, and the app installs only an update signed with this project's key. - **Release Notes** in the Help menu opens the notes for the version you have.
## Pack
- The report after packing opens at the top, and lists converted programs by name, or in one line for a whole bank. - **Clean Up Names…**: the columns fit the sheet without a horizontal scroll bar.
## Also
- The project is now called 3rd-wave-tools on GitHub (the old address redirects); the About box links to it. - [`docs/FORMATS.md`](https://github.com/adambier/3rd-wave-tools/blob/v1.0.4/docs/FORMATS.md): corrections checked against the code, and shorter. - Building from source: the first `./make-app.sh` downloads Sparkle, so it needs a network connection.
## Download
`pgdata-Packer-1.0.4.zip` below is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Requires macOS 13 or later. From this version on, the app offers later versions itself.
